title: Nagy Lajos and Workers' Rights: *köteles*, *kógens szabály*
goal: I can state a duty and a right (*köteles biztosítani*, *elidegeníthetetlen jog*, *kógens szabály*).
I can say in short sentences what a text about Nagy Lajos's book Kiskunhalom says about farm workers' lives.
I can write a sentence about what an employer or the state must do for workers.
